meta.name: optimizing-prompts
meta.description: Execute this skill optimizes prompts for large language models (llms) to reduce token usage, lower costs, and improve performance. it analyzes the prompt, identifies areas for simplification and redundancy removal, and rewrites the prompt to be more conci... Use when optimizing performance. Trigger with phrases like 'optimize', 'performance', or 'speed up'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长提示词改写成精简版,省钱提效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常使用大模型生成内容,希望降低费用并加快响应。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite verbose prompts to be concise, cutting token costs and boosting performance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly use LLM APIs and want to lower costs while getting faster responses.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析你的提示词,找出冗余和啰嗦之处,改写成更简短明确的版本,并解释改动和预期效果。用更少的 token 降低费用、提升速度,同时保持或改善输出质量。
howto.when: 当你提到「optimize」「performance」「speed up」等触发词,或要求降低成本、提升响应速度、改善输出质量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段提示词改得更简练,降低 token 用量。
say.note: Claude 会重写并说明改动。

say.text: 优化这个提示词,提高 LLM 响应速度。
say.note: 它会给出精简版并解释预期影响。

say.text: 请精简下列提示词,同时保持输出质量:
say.note: 完成后会附上 token 节省情况。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude analyzes your prompt, finds redundant or wordy parts, rewrites it into a shorter, clearer version, and explains the changes and expected impact. It uses fewer tokens to cut cost and speed up responses while keeping or improving output quality.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you mention trigger words like 'optimize', 'performance', or 'speed up', or when you ask to reduce cost, improve response speed, or enhance output quality.

say_en.text: Make this prompt more concise and reduce token usage.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite and explain changes.

say_en.text: Optimize this prompt to speed up LLM responses.
say_en.note: It will give a compact version and expected impact.

say_en.text: Tighten this prompt while keeping output quality.
